clitic(REF)
IF ?Ty(classical:t)
   (([+PROCL] & [\/1+]?Ty(x)) || (¬[+PROCL] & <\/1+>Ty(x)))
   ¬[+CLITIC]
THEN make(\/1)
   go(\/1)
   put(?Ty(classical:arrow(e,t)))
   make(\/0)
   go(\/0)
   put(Ty(classical:e))
   put(Fo(classical:REF))
   gofirst(?Ty(classical:t))
   put([+CLITIC])
ELSE abort
